object: Invented at Bell Labs in 1947 by Bardeen, Brattain, and Shockley.  A quantum-mechanical switch — its operation depends on the band theory of solids, which is a direct consequence of quantum mechanics.  The physical device that turned the probabilistic theory debated at Solvay into the substrate of computation.
